verified_behavior: All declared source and retained-backup allocation roots are canonical, disjoint, measured, and revalidated before owner validation returns.
Raw-byte mountinfo parsing preserves kernel pathname bytes and rejects malformed escapes, ambiguous stacked roots, descendant mounts and device mismatches.
Root inode/device/type and full mount identity remain bound through allocation traversal and aggregate-wide final revalidation.
tmpfs and ramfs allocations count against the 24-GiB aggregate with the pinned 12-GiB container reservation; only reviewed ext4/xfs roots are ordinary storage.
All rejection paths precede lease acquisition and Docker activity.
preserved_failure_history: The sibling-backup correction silently pruned nested device crossings and treated ramfs as zero memory.
The first expert candidate selected the first equal-length stacked mount and failed to bind root mount replacement.
The second expert candidate used Unicode whitespace parsing and did not revalidate earlier roots after later scans.

requirements: commit, push, fetch and verify these exact bytes before creating paths
fresh candidate and backup on /dev/shm; durable scratch evidence, logs, manifest and assets
at least 4 GiB free staging/emergency headroom before checkout, before conversion and after conversion
host at least 16 GiB, scratch at least 12 GiB and MemAvailable at least 16 GiB
exclusive source-object, candidate, backup and mount-topology ownership
record and reconcile exact process/session IDs and starttimes on interruption
prove exact detached main/IHK identities, clean trees, tmpfs placement and no source inode sharing
require conversion PASS, installed-only Git consumers, canonical manifest and separate verify_inputs
run BuildOwner.validate only with memory_allocation_roots containing candidate and backup
